findings.review_comment: The added path traversal check only detects '/../' sequences but can be bypassed using alternative traversal patterns like '/..\' or encoded sequences. Replace the naive string check with proper path normalization using os.path.abspath() and os.path.commonprefix() to ensure all paths remain within the restricted directory.
